regime_context: China A-shares show a narrowing, eligible-but-unconvincing leadership picture: AI Compute & Optics leads by a hair over Gold Miners, but the leader's durability (0.45) and breadth (0.235) are weak and its Hurst tag is mean-revert. Critically, the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's own history (gate_helps=false), so the one validated edge is absent here — everything below is experimental judgement, not decoder output.
emerging_watch: Watch whether AI Compute & Optics cedes the rank-1 spot to Gold Miners (margin is only 0.023): I am looking for a CONFIRMED handoff — Gold Miners holding rank 1 for two consecutive sessions while AI Compute & Optics durability stays below 0.45. If that happens, the leadership question is settled; if AI re-widens the gap, the watch retires.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: The theme tops the momentum rank but its own detector legs undermine it: mean-revert Hurst tag, durability below the 0.45 bar, and narrow breadth (0.235) suggest leadership is fragile rather than entrenched. With gate_helps=false on this market and the theme already ranked #1, chasing it offers weak asymmetry. The lean is to stand aside on fresh exposure, not to short.
theses.dissent: AI compute/optics is the dominant macro narrative (66 of 110 recent items), and narrative concentration alone can keep a theme marked up longer than fundamentals justify.

falsifier.text: AI Compute & Optics (515000.SS) closes above its prior 20-day high AND holds the rank-1 spot with durability climbing above 0.55 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners rank #2 with durability (0.93) and breadth (1.0) far superior to the leader, plus a trend Hurst tag. This is the strongest durability/cohesion profile on the board and constitutes the most credible non-AI leadership candidate. The lean is a directional preference, not a size; note the theme is unscorable (no ETF proxy), so grading is soft.
evidence: crowding_z 0.87 (elevated but not flagged crowded — size-down caution only)
theses.dissent: Gold Miners is unscorable here and gold themes often move on external USD/real-yield drivers that this China-A-share detector cannot see; a crowding_z near +1 flags reflexivity risk.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners loses its rank-2 spot to Rare Earth & Magnets or Semiconductors with its durability_bar falling below 0.60 before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: This is the only eligible theme flagged crowded=true (crowding_z 1.34), with a mixed Hurst tag and durability 0.6. Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade — but for a theme already mid-table and flagged crowded, the honest lean is to avoid fresh exposure rather than chase it.
theses.dissent: Pharma/CXO in China has idiosyncratic policy tailwinds (domestic innovative drug push) that a pure momentum lens misses, and crowding can persist in a narrative-led tape.

falsifier.text: Innovative Pharma & CXO (159992.SZ) decrowds (crowding_z drops below 0.5) AND its score rises into the top-4 eligible ranks before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
